de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 3 km sudostlich des Dorfes Agzikara und 180 m sudlich der Hauptstraﬂe zwischen Suhut und Afyon. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located 3.5 km northwest of the village of Dikici in the district of Dinar in Afyon. This area is an important crossroad from the east and south to northwest Anatolia. Both the ancient roads and the modern main roads pass by the site.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Afyon'un Dinar ilcesine bagli Dikici koyunun 3,5 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Bu bolge dogudan ve guneyden kuzeybati Anadolu'ya giden onemli bir kavsaktir. Hem antik yollar hem de modern ana yollar yerlesimin yanindan gecmektedir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 3,5 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Dikici im Bezirk Dinar in Afyon. Diese Gegend ist ein wichtiger Verkehrsknotenpunkt von Osten und Suden nach Nordwestanatolien. Sowohl die antiken Straﬂen als auch die modernen Hauptstraﬂen fuhren an dem Ort vorbei.

description: The settlement is located on the northern side of the Great Meander Valley, 600 meters north of Kabakli village in the district of Dinar.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Buyuk Menderes Vadisi'nin kuzey tarafinda, Dinar ilcesine bagli Kabakli koyunun 600 metre kuzeyinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Siedlung liegt an der Nordseite des Groﬂen Maandertals, 600 Meter nordlich des Dorfes Kabakli im Bezirk Dinar.

description: The tell settlement is located 3 km southwest of the district town of Bolvadin. Agriculture has destroyed the central part of the settlement, making the remaining parts look like three separate sites.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Bolvadin ilce merkezinin 3 km guneybatisinda yer almaktadir. Tarim, yerlesimin orta kismini tahrip etmis ve kalan kisimlarin uc ayri site gibi gorunmesine neden olmustur.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 3 km sudwestlich der Kreisstadt Bolvadin. Die Landwirtschaft hat den zentralen Teil der Siedlung zerstort, so dass die verbleibenden Teile wie drei getrennte Orte aussehen.

description: The tell settlement is located on the southeastern side of the Selcikler Municipality in the Sivasli district. Two churches were excavated in 1967. However, no further excavations have been carried out.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Sivasli ilcesindeki Selcikler Belediyesi'nin guneydogu tarafinda yer almaktadir. Iki kilise 1967 yilinda kazilmistir. Ancak daha fazla kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt an der sudostlichen Seite der Gemeinde Selcikler im Bezirk Sivasli. Im Jahr 1967 wurden zwei Kirchen ausgegraben. Es wurden jedoch keine weiteren Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The settlement is located on a natural hill 2 km northeast of the village of Budaklar in the Sivasli district of Usak. The site is about 1.5 km east of the highway between Budaklar and Kokez. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Usak'in Sivasli ilcesine bagli Budaklar koyunun 2 km kuzeydogusunda dogal bir tepe uzerinde yer almaktadir. Budaklar ile Kokez arasindaki karayolunun yaklasik 1,5 km dogusundadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Siedlung befindet sich auf einem naturlichen Hugel 2 km nordostlich des Dorfes Budaklar im Bezirk Sivasli von Usak. Die Statte liegt etwa 1,5 km ostlich der Landstraﬂe zwischen Budaklar und Kokez. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located on a natural elevation on the west side of the village of Salmanlar in the district of Sivasli. There is a well on the south side of the settlement. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Anlati yerlesimi, Sivasli ilcesine bagli Salmanlar koyunun bati tarafinda dogal bir yukselti uzerinde yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin guney tarafinda bir kuyu bulunmaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich auf einer naturlichen Anhohe an der Westseite des Dorfes Salmanlar im Bezirk Sivasli. An der Sudseite der Siedlung befindet sich ein Brunnen. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located 500 meters northwest of the village of Akarca in the district of Sivasli. It is right next to the road between Sivasli and Usak at an important junction of long-distance routes.
tr_description: Anlat yerlesimi, Sivasli ilcesine bagli Akarca koyunun 500 metre kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Sivasli ile Usak arasindaki yolun hemen yaninda, uzun mesafeli yollarin onemli bir kavsagindadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 500 Meter nordwestlich des Dorfes Akarca im Bezirk Sivasli. Sie liegt direkt an der Straﬂe zwischen Sivasli und Usak an einer wichtigen Kreuzung von Fernverkehrswegen.

description: asdasdasdasdas

The settlement is located 5 km south of the village of Bagkonak in the district of Yalvac. It is located at the natural crossroads between the towns of Yalvac, Konya, Aksehir and Isparta. No excavations have been carried out to date.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Yalvac ilcesine bagli Bagkonak koyunun 5 km guneyinde yer almaktadir. Yalvac, Konya, Aksehir ve Isparta illeri arasinda dogal bir kavsak noktasinda yer almaktadir. Bugune kadar herhangi bir kazi calismasi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Siedlung befindet sich 5 km sudlich des Dorfes Bagkonak im Bezirk Yalvac. Sie befindet sich an der naturlichen Kreuzung zwischen den Stadten Yalvac, Konya, Aksehir und Isparta. Bislang wurden keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located between the villages of Arak and Calti in the Sarkikaraagac district of Isparta. The highway between Isparta Beysehir and Konya was built through the settlement and parts of the settlement were destroyed. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Isparta'nin Sarkikaraagac ilcesine bagli Arak ve Calti koyleri arasinda yer almaktadir. Isparta Beysehir ile Konya arasindaki karayolu yerlesimin icinden gecirilmis ve yerlesimin bir kismi tahrip edilmistir. Bugune kadar herhangi bir kazi calismasi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich zwischen den Dorfern Arak und Calti im Sarkikaraagac Bezirk von Isparta. Die Schnellstraﬂe zwischen Isparta Beysehir und Konya wurde durch die Siedlung gebaut und Teile der Siedlung wurden zerstort. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.3 km north-east of the village of Ordekci in the district of Sarkikaraagac. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Sarkikaraagac ilcesine bagli Ordekci koyunun 1,3 km kuzeydogusunda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1,3 km nordostlich des Dorfes Ordekci im Bezirk Sarkikaraagac. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is right next to the eastern shores of Lake Egirdir, 10 km southwest of the district town of Gelendost in Isparta. It was named harbor pier (Iskele). No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Isparta'nin Gelendost ilcesinin 10 km guneybatisinda, Egirdir Golu'nun dogu kiyisinin hemen yanindadir. Liman iskelesi (Iskele) olarak adlandirilmistir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi calismasi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt direkt am Ostufer des Egirdir-Sees, 10 km sudwestlich der Kreisstadt Gelendost in Isparta. Sie wurde Hafenmole (Iskele) genannt. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is on the west side of the main road between Isparta and Yalvac, 1 km south of the district town of Gelendost. No excavations have been carried out to date.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Isparta ile Yalvac arasindaki ana yolun bati tarafinda, Gelendost ilcesinin 1 km guneyindedir. Bugune kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt an der Westseite der Hauptstraﬂe zwischen Isparta und Yalvac, 1 km sudlich der Kreisstadt Gelendost. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located on the south-eastern side of the highway between Isparta and Egirdir, 2 km west of the village of Buyukgokceli in the province of Isparta. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Isparta iline bagli Buyukgokceli koyunun 2 km batisinda, Isparta ile Egirdir arasindaki karayolunun guneydogu tarafinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich auf der sudostlichen Seite der Landstraﬂe zwischen Isparta und Egirdir, 2 km westlich des Dorfes Buyukgokceli in der Provinz Isparta. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.3 km east of the village of Harmanoren in the district of Atabey. No excavations have been carried out so far. However, a cemetery about 300 m northeast of the site was excavated between 1989 and 2005. It yielded many Early Bronze Age and few Middle Bronze Age finds.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Atabey ilcesine bagli Harmanoren koyunun 1,3 km dogusunda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir. Ancak yerlesimin yaklasik 300 m kuzeydogusunda yer alan bir mezarlik 1989-2005 yillari arasinda kazilmistir. Bu kazida cok sayida Ilk Tunc Cagi ve az sayida Orta Tunc Cagi buluntusu ele gecmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1,3 km ostlich des Dorfes Harmanoren im Bezirk Atabey. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt. Allerdings wurde zwischen 1989 und 2005 ein Friedhof etwa 300 m nordostlich der Statte ausgegraben. Es erbrachte viele Funde aus der fruhen Bronzezeit und wenige aus der mittleren Bronzezeit.

description: The tell settlement is located 400 m south of the highway between the villages of Kumdanli and Senirkenc and 6 km southwest of Kumdanli in the district of Yalvac. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Yalvac ilcesine bagli Kumdanli ve Senirkenc koyleri arasindaki karayolunun 400 m guneyinde ve Kumdanli'nin 6 km guneybatisinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt 400 m sudlich der Fernstraﬂe zwischen den Dorfern Kumdanli und Senirkenc und 6 km sudwestlich von Kumdanli im Bezirk Yalvac. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is said to be located 11.5 km southwest of the district town of Gelendost. No excavations have been carried out so far. We were unable to find it.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesiminin Gelendost ilcesinin 11,5 km guneybatisinda yer aldigi soylenmektedir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir. Biz de bulamadik.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung soll sich 11,5 km sudwestlich der Kreisstadt Gelendost befinden. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt. Wir haben sie nicht finden konnen.

description: The tell settlement is located on the south side of the village of Ayvali in the district of Yalvac. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Yalvac ilcesine bagli Ayvali koyunun guney tarafinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich an der Sudseite des Dorfes Ayvali im Bezirk Yalvac. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located in a place called Ciftlik, 2 km southwest of Cavdir. There is an important water source 200 m southwest of the settlement. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Cavdir'in 2 km guneybatisinda Ciftlik denilen yerde bulunmaktadir. Yerlesimin 200 m guneybatisinda onemli bir su kaynagi bulunmaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich in einem Ort namens Ciftlik, 2 km sudwestlich von Cavdir. 200 m sudwestlich der Siedlung befindet sich eine wichtige Wasserquelle. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located 2 km south-east of the village of Bogazici in the province of Burdur. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Burdur iline bagli Bogazici koyunun 2 km guneydogusunda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 2 km sudostlich des Dorfes Bogazici in der Provinz Burdur. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located within the boundaries of the village of Haciveliler in the district of Golmarmara and the province of Manisa. South of the village (and west of Lake Marmara Golu) is the Gur Dagi ridge, on the southern side of which is Kaymakci.
tr_description: Anlati yerlesimi, Golmarmara ilcesi ve Manisa iline bagli Haciveliler koyu sinirlari icinde yer almaktadir. Koyun guneyinde (ve Marmara Golu'nun batisinda) Gur Dagi sirti, guney tarafinda ise Kaymakci yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich innerhalb der Grenzen des Dorfes Haciveliler im Bezirk Golmarmara und der Provinz Manisa. Sudlich des Dorfes (und westlich des Marmara Golu Sees) befindet sich der Gur Dagi Bergrucken, an dessen Sudseite Kaymakci liegt.

description: The tell settlement is located near the modern settlement of Seki in the district town of Fethiye in Mugla, 12 km south of Caltilar Hoyuk.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Mugla'nin Fethiye ilcesindeki modern Seki yerlesiminin yakininda, Caltilar Hoyuk'un 12 km guneyinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich in der Nahe der modernen Siedlung Seki in der Kreisstadt Fethiye in Mugla, 12 km sudlich von Caltilar Hoyuk.

description: The tell settlement is located north of Incealiler village in the district of Fethiye. It is about 18 km southwest of the settlement of Caltilar and 8 km west of Eceler Hoyuk. No excavations have been carried out.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Fethiye ilcesine bagli Incealiler koyunun kuzeyinde yer almaktadir. Caltilar yerlesiminin yaklasik 18 km guneybatisinda ve Eceler Hoyuk'un 8 km batisindadir. Herhangi bir kazi calismasi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich nordlich des Dorfes Incealiler im Bezirk Fethiye. Sie liegt etwa 18 km sudwestlich der Siedlung Caltilar und 8 km westlich von Eceler Hoyuk. Es sind keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt worden.

description: The ancient city lies west of the modern village Minare in the district of Fethiye. No Bronze Age settlement remains have yet been found, but no targeted investigations have been carried out either.
tr_description: Antik kent, Fethiye ilcesindeki modern Minare koyunun batisinda yer almaktadir. Henuz herhangi bir Tunc Cagi yerlesim kalintisina rastlanmamistir, ancak hedefe yonelik arastirmalar da yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die antike Stadt liegt westlich des modernen Dorfes Minare im Bezirk Fethiye. Es wurden noch keine bronzezeitlichen Siedlungsreste gefunden, aber es wurden auch keine gezielten Untersuchungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The settlement is located 4 km north of Edirne city center, on the west bank of the Tunca River, just off the road to the village of Avariz.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Edirne sehir merkezinin 4 km kuzeyinde, Tunca Nehri'nin bati yakasinda, Avariz koyune giden yolun hemen disinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Siedlung liegt 4 km nordlich des Stadtzentrums von Edirne, am Westufer des Flusses Tunca, direkt an der Straﬂe zum Dorf Avariz.

description: The tell settlement is 8 km north of the Edirne city center on the west coast of the Tunca River. The site lies on private property.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Edirne sehir merkezinin 8 km kuzeyinde, Tunca Nehri'nin bati kiyisindadir. Yerlesim yeri ozel mulkiyete aittir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt 8 km nordlich des Stadtzentrums von Edirne an der Westkuste des Flusses Tunca. Die Statte liegt auf einem Privatgrundstuck.

description: The tell settlement is located 10 km north of Edirne city center and 1 km west of the village of Avariz.
tr_description: Anlat yerlesimi Edirne sehir merkezinin 10 km kuzeyinde ve Avariz koyunun 1 km batisinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 10 km nordlich des Stadtzentrums von Edirne und 1 km westlich des Dorfes Avariz.

description: The tell settlement is located on a natural hill on the west side of the river Tunca, 1 km northwest of the village.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, koyun 1 km kuzeybatisinda, Tunca Nehri'nin bati yakasinda dogal bir tepe uzerinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich auf einem naturlichen Hugel auf der Westseite des Flusses Tunca, 1 km nordwestlich des Dorfes.

description: The tell settlement is located on a natural hill on the eastern side of the Tunca River, 2 km south of the village of Yolustu in the province of Edirne.
tr_description: Anlati yerlesimi, Edirne iline bagli Yolustu koyunun 2 km guneyinde, Tunca Nehri'nin dogu yakasinda dogal bir tepe uzerinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt auf einem naturlichen Hugel an der Ostseite des Flusses Tunca, 2 km sudlich des Dorfes Yolustu in der Provinz Edirne.

description: The tell settlement is located about 1 km west of the village of Hatipkoy. The place was founded on the edge of a natural hill. According to Burcin Erdogdu, the settlement has a diameter of 80 meters and is about 1 meter high.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Hatipkoy koyunun yaklasik 1 km batisinda yer almaktadir. Dogal bir tepenin kenarinda kurulmustur. Burcin Erdogdu'ya gore yerlesim 80 metre capinda ve yaklasik 1 metre yuksekligindedir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich etwa 1 km westlich des Dorfes Hatipkoy. Der Ort wurde am Rande eines naturlichen Hugels gegrundet. Nach Angaben von Burcin Erdogdu hat die Siedlung einen Durchmesser von 80 Metern und ist etwa 1 Meter hoch.

description: The Tell settlement is located on the eastern side of the Tunca River, about 2.5 km southeast of the village of Avariz in Edirne province. Today, the settlement is almost completely eroded. However, Late Bronze Age and Early Iron Age pottery has been found on the surface.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Edirne iline bagli Avariz koyunun yaklasik 2,5 km guneydogusunda, Tunca Nehri'nin dogu yakasinda yer almaktadir. Yerlesim gunumuzde neredeyse tamamen asinmis durumdadir. Ancak yuzeyde Gec Tunc Cagi ve Erken Demir Cagi canak comlekleri bulunmustur.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich auf der ostlichen Seite des Flusses Tunca, etwa 2,5 km sudostlich des Dorfes Avariz in der Provinz Edirne. Heute ist die Siedlung fast vollstandig erodiert. An der Oberflache wurde jedoch Keramik aus der spaten Bronzezeit und fruhen Eisenzeit gefunden.

description: The settlement is located 2.5 km northwest of Edirne city center. According to surface finds, the settlement was established in the late Bronze and Iron Ages. After that, it was settled again in the Classical period.
tr_description: Yerlesim Edirne sehir merkezinin 2,5 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Yuzey buluntularina gore yerlesim Gec Tunc ve Demir Caglarinda kurulmustur. Daha sonra Klasik donemde tekrar yerlesime acilmistir.
de_description: Die Siedlung befindet sich 2,5 km nordwestlich des Stadtzentrums von Edirne. Den Oberflachenfunden zufolge wurde die Siedlung in der spaten Bronze- und Eisenzeit gegrundet. Danach wurde sie in klassischer Zeit erneut besiedelt.

description: The Tell settlement is located on the east side of the Tunca River, 6 km north of Edirne city center.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Edirne sehir merkezinin 6 km kuzeyinde, Tunca Nehri'nin dogu yakasinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich auf der Ostseite des Tunca-Flusses, 6 km nordlich des Stadtzentrums von Edirne.

description: The tell settlement is located 1 km north-east of the village of Ortakci and 4 km south of the district town of Lalapasa. Directly opposite the site lies the Neolithic settlement of Kavakli.
tr_description: Tell yerlesimi, Ortakci koyunun 1 km kuzeydogusunda ve Lalapasa ilcesinin 4 km guneyinde yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin tam karsisinda Kavakli Neolitik Cag yerlesimi bulunmaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1 km nordostlich des Dorfes Ortakci und 4 km sudlich der Kreisstadt Lalapasa. Direkt gegenuber der Statte liegt die neolithische Siedlung von Kavakli.

description: The tell settlement is located on the west side of Suloglu stream, 2 km north of Kukuler village and 4 km south of Suloglu district town in Edirne province. There are two burial mounds in the area.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Edirne iline bagli Suloglu ilce merkezinin 4 km guneyinde, Kukuler koyunun 2 km kuzeyinde, Suloglu deresinin bati yakasinda yer almaktadir. Bolgede iki adet mezar hoyugu bulunmaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich auf der Westseite des Suloglu-Bachs, 2 km nordlich des Dorfes Kukuler und 4 km sudlich der Kreisstadt Suloglu in der Provinz Edirne. In der Gegend gibt es zwei Grabhugel.

description: The tell settlement is located 1 km north of Kukuler village in Suloglu district and Edirne province. A large number of Classical period pottery has been found on the surface. There are also a few pieces of late Bronze Age and Iron Age pottery.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Edirne ili, Suloglu ilcesi, Kukuler koyunun 1 km kuzeyinde yer almaktadir. Yuzeyde cok sayida Klasik Donem canak comlegi bulunmustur. Ayrica birkac parca Gec Tunc Cagi ve Demir Cagi canak comlegi de bulunmaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1 km nordlich des Dorfes Kukuler im Bezirk Suloglu in der Provinz Edirne. An der Oberflache wurde eine groﬂe Anzahl von Keramik aus der klassischen Periode gefunden. Es gibt auch ein paar Stucke Keramik aus der spaten Bronzezeit und der Eisenzeit.

description: The tell settlement is located about 1.5 km north of the village of Arpac in the district of Havsa and the province of Edirne. A road runs right through the settlement. A tumulus is still preserved on the site.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Edirne ilinin Havsa ilcesine bagli Arpac koyunun yaklasik 1,5 km kuzeyinde yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin icinden bir yol gecmektedir. Yerlesim yerinde bir tumulus hala korunmaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt etwa 1,5 km nordlich des Dorfes Arpac im Bezirk Havsa und in der Provinz Edirne. Eine Straﬂe fuhrt direkt durch die Siedlung. Auf dem Gelande ist noch ein Grabhugel erhalten.

description: The settlement is located on the west side of Suloglu stream, 1 km south of Musulca village in Havsa/Edirne district. Part of the settlement is destroyed.
tr_description: Yerlesim Havsa/Edirne ilcesine bagli Musulca koyunun 1 km guneyinde, Suloglu deresinin bati yakasinda yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin bir kismi yikilmistir.
de_description: Die Siedlung befindet sich auf der Westseite des Suloglu-Bachs, 1 km sudlich des Dorfes Musulca im Bezirk Havsa/Edirne. Ein Teil der Siedlung ist zerstort.

description: The tell settlement is located 2 km south of the village of Arpac in the district town of Havsa/Edirne.
tr_description: Soz konusu yerlesim Havsa/Edirne ilcesine bagli Arpac koyunun 2 km guneyinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 2 km sudlich des Dorfes Arpac in der Kreisstadt Havsa/Edirne.

description: The Tell settlement is located on the west side of Suloglu stream, 400 meters south of Haskoy village in Havsa district of Edirne province. The flat area of the settlement is 100 meters wide.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Edirne ilinin Havsa ilcesine bagli Haskoy koyunun 400 metre guneyinde, Suloglu deresinin bati yakasinda yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin duzluk alani 100 metre genisligindedir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich auf der Westseite des Suloglu-Bachs, 400 Meter sudlich des Dorfes Haskoy im Bezirk Havsa der Provinz Edirne. Die flache Flache der Siedlung ist 100 Meter breit.

description: The tell settlement is located on the eastern side of the Disbudak stream, 1 km south of the village of Buyuk Altiagac in the district of Meric and the province of Edirne.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Edirne ilinin Meric ilcesine bagli Buyuk Altiagac koyunun 1 km guneyinde, Disbudak deresinin dogu yakasinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich auf der ostlichen Seite des Disbudak-Bachs, 1 km sudlich des Dorfes Buyuk Altiagac im Bezirk Meric und der Provinz Edirne.

description: The Tell settlement is located on the northwestern side of Kadidondurma in the Meric district of Edirne province. The settlement has been partially destroyed by the expansion of a modern village.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Edirne ilinin Meric ilcesine bagli Kadidondurma'nin kuzeybati tarafinda yer almaktadir. Yerlesim, modern bir koyun genislemesiyle kismen tahrip olmustur.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich an der nordwestlichen Seite von Kadidondurma im Bezirk Meric der Provinz Edirne. Die Siedlung wurde durch die Ausdehnung eines modernen Dorfes teilweise zerstort.

description: The tell settlement was built on a rocky outcrop 3 km east of Gumuscay village in Alasehir district, Manisa province. The site was discovered by Engin Akdeniz in 2007.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Manisa ili Alasehir ilcesi Gumuscay koyunun 3 km dogusundaki kayalik bir cikinti uzerine kurulmustur. Yerlesim 2007 yilinda Engin Akdeniz tarafindan kesfedilmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung wurde auf einem Felsvorsprung 3 km ostlich des Dorfes Gumuscay im Bezirk Alasehir in der Provinz Manisa errichtet. Die Statte wurde von Engin Akdeniz im Jahr 2007 entdeckt.

description: The tell settlement is located 5 km west of the village of Erdelli and 2 km southeast of the village of Buknus in the district of Akhisar and the province of Manisa. The site measures 140 x 90 meters and is 12 meters high. It was first explored by Rafet Dinc in the 1990s. In 2007, Engin Akdeniz re-examined the site.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Manisa ili Akhisar ilcesine bagli Erdelli koyunun 5 km batisinda ve Buknus koyunun 2 km guneydogusunda yer almaktadir. Yerlesim 140 x 90 metre olculerinde ve 12 metre yuksekligindedir. Ilk olarak 1990'li yillarda Rafet Dinc tarafindan kesfedilmistir. 2007 yilinda Engin Akdeniz tarafindan yeniden incelenmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 5 km westlich des Dorfes Erdelli und 2 km sudostlich des Dorfes Buknus im Bezirk Akhisar und der Provinz Manisa. Die Statte misst 140 x 90 Meter und ist 12 Meter hoch. Sie wurde erstmals in den 1990er Jahren von Rafet Dinc erforscht. Im Jahr 2007 untersuchte Engin Akdeniz die Statte erneut.

description: The tell settlement is located 200 meters northwest of the village of Pinarcik in the district of Akhisar and the province of Manisa. It was first discovered and studied by David French.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Manisa ilinin Akhisar ilcesine bagli Pinarcik koyunun 200 metre kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Ilk olarak David French tarafindan kesfedilmis ve incelenmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 200 Meter nordwestlich des Dorfes Pinarcik im Bezirk Akhisar und der Provinz Manisa. Sie wurde erstmals von David French entdeckt und untersucht.

description: The tell settlement is located 2.2 km south of the village of Rahmiye in the district of Akhisar and the province of Manisa.
tr_description: Soz konusu yerlesim, Akhisar ilcesi ve Manisa iline bagli Rahmiye koyunun 2,2 km guneyinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 2,2 km sudlich des Dorfes Rahmiye im Bezirk Akhisar und der Provinz Manisa.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.2 km southwest of Kulaksizlar village in Akhisar district and Manisa province. Many idols dating back to the Bronze Age have been found at the site. According to the researchers, this place was an important workshop in pre-Bronze Age western Asia Minor. Engin Akdeniz saw a lot of Late Bronze Age pottery at this site.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Manisa ili, Akhisar ilcesi, Kulaksizlar koyunun 1,2 km guneybatisinda yer almaktadir. Alanda Tunc Cagi'na tarihlenen cok sayida idol bulunmustur. Arastirmacilara gore, burasi Tunc Cagi oncesi Bati Kucuk Asya'da onemli bir atolyeydi. Engin Akdeniz bu alanda cok sayida Gec Tunc Cagi canak comlegi gormustur.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1,2 km sudwestlich des Dorfes Kulaksizlar im Bezirk Akhisar in der Provinz Manisa. An der Statte wurden viele Idole aus der Bronzezeit gefunden. Den Forschern zufolge war dieser Ort eine wichtige Werkstatt im vorbronzezeitlichen westlichen Kleinasien. Engin Akdeniz entdeckte an diesem Ort eine Menge spatbronzezeitlicher Topferwaren.

description: The tell settlement is located 3 km northwest of the village of Alibeyli in the district of Saruhanli and the province of Manisa. It was first mentioned by David French and later re-examined by Engin Akdeniz.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Manisa iline bagli Saruhanli ilcesinin Alibeyli koyunun 3 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Ilk olarak David French tarafindan bahsedilmis ve daha sonra Engin Akdeniz tarafindan yeniden incelenmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 3 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Alibeyli im Bezirk Saruhanli und der Provinz Manisa. Sie wurde erstmals von David French erwahnt und spater von Engin Akdeniz neu untersucht.

description: The tell settlement is located 4 km southeast of the village of Mutevelli in the district of Saruhanli and the province of Manisa. According to Engin Akdeniz, a large part of the tell's extent has disappeared. The original size of the site can no longer be determined. The height is 4 m.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Manisa ilinin Saruhanli ilcesine bagli Mutevelli koyunun 4 km guneydogusunda yer almaktadir. Engin Akdeniz'e gore, anlati alaninin buyuk bir kismi yok olmustur. Alanin orijinal boyutu artik tespit edilememektedir. Yuksekligi 4 m'dir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 4 km sudostlich des Dorfes Mutevelli im Bezirk Saruhanli und der Provinz Manisa. Nach Angaben von Engin Akdeniz ist ein groﬂer Teil der Ausdehnung des Tells verschwunden. Die ursprungliche Groﬂe der Anlage kann nicht mehr bestimmt werden. Die Hohe betragt 4 m.

description: The tell settlement is located on the southwestern side of the highway between Alibeyli and the small town of Halitpasa, 2 km east of Halitpasa. It was first discovered by David French in the 1960s. At that time, the Chalcolithic and Early Bronze Age pottery was identified. In 2007, the site was investigated by Engin Akdeniz, who also found Middle Bronze Age and Late Bronze Age pottery.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Alibeyli ile kucuk Halitpasa kasabasi arasindaki karayolunun guneybati tarafinda, Halitpasa'nin 2 km dogusunda yer almaktadir. Ilk olarak 1960'larda David French tarafindan kesfedilmistir. O donemde Kalkolitik ve Erken Tunc Cagi canak comlekleri tespit edilmistir. Alan 2007 yilinda Engin Akdeniz tarafindan incelenmis ve Orta Tunc Cagi ve Gec Tunc Cagi canak comlekleri de bulunmustur.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich auf der sudwestlichen Seite der Autobahn zwischen Alibeyli und der kleinen Stadt Halitpasa, 2 km ostlich von Halitpasa. Sie wurde erstmals in den 1960er Jahren von David French entdeckt. Damals wurde die chalkolithische und fruhbronzezeitliche Keramik identifiziert. Im Jahr 2007 wurde die Statte von Engin Akdeniz untersucht, der auch Keramik aus der Mittel- und Spatbronzezeit fand.

description: The settlement is located 2 km. northwest of the village of Alibeyli in the district of Saruhanli and the province of Manisa. It is established on a natural hill.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Manisa ilinin Saruhanli ilcesine bagli Alibeyli koyunun 2 km. kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Dogal bir tepe uzerine kurulmustur.
de_description: Die Siedlung liegt 2 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Alibeyli im Bezirk Saruhanli und in der Provinz Manisa. Sie ist auf einem naturlichen Hugel errichtet.

description: The tell settlement is located 1 km southwest of the village of Gulbahce in the province of Manisa. It was first discovered by David French.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Manisa iline bagli Gulbahce koyunun 1 km guneybatisinda yer almaktadir. Ilk olarak David French tarafindan kesfedilmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1 km sudwestlich des Dorfes Gulbahce in der Provinz Manisa. Sie wurde erstmals von David French entdeckt.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.5 km northwest of the village of Veziroglu in the province of Manisa. It was first discovered and investigated by David French.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Manisa iline bagli Veziroglu koyunun 1,5 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Ilk olarak David French tarafindan kesfedilmis ve incelenmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1,5 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Veziroglu in der Provinz Manisa. Sie wurde erstmals von David French entdeckt und untersucht.

description: The settlement is located northwest of the village of Kilcanlar in the district of Golmarmara. Like Kaymakci, it is founded on a ridge and lies about 155 meters above the floodplain. It appears like a citadel, 3. 8 ha in size.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Golmarmara ilcesine bagli Kilcanlar koyunun kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Kaymakci gibi bir sirt uzerine kurulmustur ve taskin yatagindan yaklasik 155 metre yuksekliktedir. Bir kale gorunumundedir ve 3.8 hektar buyuklugundedir.
de_description: Die Siedlung befindet sich nordwestlich des Dorfes Kilcanlar im Bezirk Golmarmara. Wie Kaymakci ist sie auf einem Bergrucken gegrundet und liegt etwa 155 Meter uber der Flussaue. Sie sieht aus wie eine Zitadelle und ist 3,8 ha groﬂ.

description: The Tell settlement is located on a hill called Kizbaci Tepesi in Turkish on the northeast side of Lake Marmara. It is located. It was probably a citadel of about 1 ha in size.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Marmara Golu'nun kuzeydogu tarafinda Turkce'de Kizbaci Tepesi olarak adlandirilan bir tepe uzerinde yer almaktadir. Bulundugu yer. Muhtemelen yaklasik 1 hektar buyuklugunde bir kaleydi.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich auf einem Hugel, der auf Turkisch Kizbaci Tepesi genannt wird, auf der Nordostseite des Marmarasees. Sie befindet sich dort. Sie war wahrscheinlich eine Zitadelle von etwa 1 ha Groﬂe.

description: The site is located on the north-western side of Lake Marmara in the province of Manisa.
tr_description: Saha, Marmara Golu'nun kuzeybati yakasinda, Manisa ilinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Der Ort befindet sich auf der nordwestlichen Seite des Marmara-Sees in der Provinz Manisa.

description: The tell settlement is located 3 km west of the district center Gomec in Balikesir.
tr_description: Anlati yerlesimi Balikesir'in Gomec ilce merkezinin 3 km batisinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 3 km westlich des Bezirkszentrums Gomec in Balikesir.

description: The prehistoric settlement is located on a natural hill southwest of the village of Kirazli in the province of Aydin. The pottery covers the entire Bronze Age and Classical periods. Sevinc Gunel has characterized the size considers an acropolis. Whether it was a fortress or a settlement is not entirely clear.
tr_description: Tarih oncesi yerlesim, Aydin iline bagli Kirazli koyunun guneybatisinda dogal bir tepe uzerinde yer almaktadir. Canak comlekler tum Tunc Cagi ve Klasik donemleri kapsamaktadir. Sevinc Gunel'in tanimladigi buyuklukte bir akropol oldugu dusunulmektedir. Bir kale mi yoksa bir yerlesim yeri mi oldugu tam olarak belli degildir.
de_description: Die prahistorische Siedlung befindet sich auf einem naturlichen Hugel sudwestlich des Dorfes Kirazli in der Provinz Aydin. Die Topferwaren decken die gesamte Bronzezeit und die klassische Periode ab. Sevinc Gunel hat die Groﬂe charakterisiert halt eine Akropolis. Ob es eine Festung oder eine Siedlung war, ist nicht ganz klar.

description: The tell settlement is located south of the village of Cambel in the district of Kemalpasa and the province of Izmir.
tr_description: Anlati yerlesimi, Kemalpasa ilcesi ve Izmir iline bagli Cambel koyunun guneyinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich sudlich des Dorfes Cambel im Bezirk Kemalpasa und der Provinz Izmir.

description: The tell settlement is located 1 km northwest of the village of Umur in the district of Cine and the province of Aydin.
tr_description: Anlati yerlesimi, Cine ilcesi ve Aydin iline bagli Umur koyunun 1 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Umur im Bezirk Cine und der Provinz Aydin.

description: The tell settlement is located within the boundaries of Hamzabali village in Yenipazar district and Aydin province. Sevinc Gunel registered it under the name of the neighboring village. It is also known as Hamzabali Hoyuk.
tr_description: Aydin ili, Yenipazar ilcesi, Hamzabali koyu sinirlari icerisinde yer almaktadir. Sevinc Gunel tarafindan komsu koyun adiyla tescil edilmistir. Hamzabali Hoyuk olarak da bilinmektedir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich innerhalb der Grenzen des Dorfes Hamzabali im Bezirk Yenipazar und der Provinz Aydin. Sevinc Gunel hat sie unter dem Namen des benachbarten Dorfes registriert. Sie ist auch als Hamzabali Hoyuk bekannt.

description: The Tell settlement is located near the Nazilli-Bozdogan road within the boundaries of Kavakli village, Bozdogan district and Aydin province. Large parts of the settlement have been destroyed. The current height is between 2-3 meters; the former extent cannot be determined.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Aydin ili, Bozdogan ilcesi, Kavakli koyu sinirlari icerisinde, Nazilli-Bozdogan yolu yakininda yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin buyuk bir kismi tahrip olmustur. Mevcut yuksekligi 2-3 metre arasindadir; eski boyutu tespit edilememistir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich in der Nahe der Straﬂe Nazilli-Bozdogan innerhalb der Grenzen des Dorfes Kavakli, des Bezirks Bozdogan und der Provinz Aydin. Groﬂe Teile der Siedlung sind zerstort worden. Die heutige Hohe liegt zwischen 2-3 Metern; die fruhere Ausdehnung kann nicht bestimmt werden.

description: The tell settlement is located 1 km south-east of the village of Elmacik in the province of Usak. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Usak iline bagli Elmacik koyunun 1 km guneydogusunda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1 km sudostlich des Dorfes Elmacik in der Provinz Usak. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The Tell settlement is located in the center of Izmir on the outskirts of Bornava. Part of the settlement has been destroyed and built over in the last 20 years. The settlement was excavated after 2010 under the direction of Zafer Derin.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Izmir'in merkezinde, Bornava'nin eteklerinde yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin bir kismi son 20 yilda tahrip edilmis ve uzerine insaat yapilmistir. Yerlesim 2010 yilindan sonra Zafer Derin baskanliginda kazilmistir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich im Zentrum von Izmir am Rande von Bornava. Ein Teil der Siedlung wurde in den letzten 20 Jahren zerstort und uberbaut. Die Siedlung wurde nach 2010 unter der Leitung von Zafer Derin ausgegraben.

description: The settlement is located on a natural hill on the northern side of the village of Yenikoy in the province of Bilecik. The size of the settlement area is about 100 x 100 meters.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Bilecik iline bagli Yenikoy koyunun kuzey tarafinda dogal bir tepe uzerinde yer almaktadir. Yerlesim alaninin buyuklugu yaklasik 100 x 100 metredir.
de_description: Die Siedlung befindet sich auf einem naturlichen Hugel an der Nordseite des Dorfes Yenikoy in der Provinz Bilecik. Die Groﬂe der Siedlungsflache betragt etwa 100 x 100 Meter.

description: The Tell settlement is located in a marshy area 1.5 km southwest of the village of Eldere in the Dinar district and Afyonkarahisar province. A railway line built 100 years ago crosses the settlement from west to east.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ili Dinar ilcesi Eldere koyunun 1,5 km guneybatisinda bataklik bir alanda yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin batisindan dogusuna 100 yil once insa edilmis bir demiryolu hatti gecmektedir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung liegt in einem sumpfigen Gebiet 1,5 km sudwestlich des Dorfes Eldere im Bezirk Dinar und der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Eine vor 100 Jahren gebaute Eisenbahnlinie durchquert die Siedlung von Westen nach Osten.

description: The tell settlement is located about 1 km northwest of the village of Akgun in the district of Dinar and the province of Afyonkarahisar. The eastern slope of the settlement has been cut off by a road.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Dinar ilcesine bagli Akgun koyunun yaklasik 1 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin dogu yamaci bir yol ile kesilmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt etwa 1 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Akgun im Bezirk Dinar und in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Der Osthang der Siedlung wurde durch eine Straﬂe abgeschnitten.

description: The tell settlement is located on the eastern side of the village of Dombay in the district of Dinar and the province of Afyon.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Dinar ilcesi ve Afyon iline bagli Dombay koyunun dogu tarafinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt an der ostlichen Seite des Dorfes Dombay im Bezirk Dinar und in der Provinz Afyon.

description: The tell settlement is located about 250 meters northeast of the village of Cayustu in the district of Dinar.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Dinar ilcesine bagli Cayustu koyunun yaklasik 250 metre kuzeydogusunda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich etwa 250 Meter nordostlich des Dorfes Cayustu im Bezirk Dinar.

description: The tell settlement is located 750 m northwest of the village of Cumhuriyet in the district of Dinar. The site is 120 x 190 m and 5 m high.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Dinar ilcesine bagli Cumhuriyet koyunun 750 m kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Alan 120 x 190 m boyutlarinda ve 5 m yuksekligindedir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 750 m nordwestlich des Dorfes Cumhuriyet im Bezirk Dinar. Die Anlage ist 120 x 190 m groﬂ und 5 m hoch.

description: The tell settlement is located 3.5 km southeast of the village of Gocerli, 3 km west of Kinik and 5 km northwest of the village of Tatarli in the district of Dinar.
tr_description: Anlati yerlesimi, Dinar ilcesine bagli Gocerli koyunun 3,5 km guneydogusunda, Kinik'in 3 km batisinda ve Tatarli koyunun 5 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 3,5 km sudostlich des Dorfes Gocerli, 3 km westlich von Kinik und 5 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Tatarli im Bezirk Dinar.

description: The tell settlement is located 2.3 km southeast of the village of Haydarli in the district of Dinar and the province of Afyon.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyon ilinin Dinar ilcesine bagli Haydarli koyunun 2,3 km guneydogusunda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 2,3 km sudostlich des Dorfes Haydarli im Bezirk Dinar und der Provinz Afyon.

description: The tell settlement is located on the south side of the village of Akpinarli in the district of Dinar and the province of Afyon.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Dinar ilcesi ve Afyon iline bagli Akpinarli koyunun guney tarafinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich an der Sudseite des Dorfes Akpinarli im Bezirk Dinar und der Provinz Afyon.

description: The Tell settlement is located on the north-western side of the village of Alparslan in the district town of Dinar in the province of Afyon. The village houses were built on a part of the settlement. The highway between the district towns of Cay and Dinar runs right next to the settlement.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyon ilinin Dinar ilcesine bagli Alparslan koyunun kuzeybati tarafinda yer almaktadir. Koy evleri yerlesimin bir bolumu uzerine insa edilmistir. Cay ve Dinar ilceleri arasindaki karayolu yerlesimin hemen yanindan gecmektedir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich an der nordwestlichen Seite des Dorfes Alparslan in der Kreisstadt Dinar in der Provinz Afyon. Die Hauser des Dorfes wurden auf einem Teil der Siedlung errichtet. Die Landstraﬂe zwischen den Kreisstadten Cay und Dinar fuhrt direkt an der Siedlung vorbei.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.3 km northeast of the village of Okcular and 1.1 km northwest of the village of Kadilar in the Dinar District of Afyon Province.
tr_description: Soz konusu yerlesim, Afyon Ili Dinar Ilcesi'ne bagli Okcular Koyu'nun 1,3 km kuzeydogusunda ve Kadilar Koyu'nun 1,1 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1,3 km nordostlich des Dorfes Okcular und 1,1 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Kadilar im Bezirk Dinar der Provinz Afyon.

description: The tell settlement is located about 2 km northeast of Bagcilar village in Dinar district of Afyonkarahisar province. The settlement consists of two hills: the northwestern one is called Kucuk (small) Cataltepe and the southeastern one is called Buyuk (big) Cataltepe. The small one has a diameter of 300 meters and a height of 3-4 meters. The big one has a diameter of 300 meters and a height of 5-6 meters.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Dinar ilcesine bagli Bagcilar koyunun yaklasik 2 km kuzeydogusunda yer almaktadir. Yerlesim iki tepeden olusmaktadir: kuzeybatidaki Kucuk Cataltepe ve guneydogudaki Buyuk Cataltepe olarak adlandirilmaktadir. Kucuk olanin capi 300 metre ve yuksekligi 3-4 metredir. Buyuk olanin capi 300 metre ve yuksekligi 5-6 metredir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich etwa 2 km nordostlich des Dorfes Bagcilar im Bezirk Dinar der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Die Siedlung besteht aus zwei Hugeln: der nordwestliche wird Kucuk (kleiner) Cataltepe genannt und der sudostliche heiﬂt Buyuk (groﬂer) Cataltepe. Der kleine hat einen Durchmesser von 300 Metern und eine Hohe von 3-4 Metern. Der groﬂe hat einen Durchmesser von 300 Metern und eine Hohe von 5-6 Metern.

description: The tell settlement is located on the south side of the village of Karabedir in the district of Dinar in the province of Afyonkarahisar. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Dinar ilcesine bagli Karabedir koyunun guney tarafinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich an der Sudseite des Dorfes Karabedir im Bezirk Dinar in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located 2.5 km northeast of the village of Yuregil in the district of Dazkari in the province of Afyonkarahisar.
tr_description: Anlati yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Dazkari ilcesine bagli Yuregil koyunun 2,5 km kuzeydogusunda yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 2,5 km nordostlich des Dorfes Yuregil im Bezirk Dazkari in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar.

description: The tell settlement is located on the south and southeast side of Sarikavak village in Dazkiri district of Aydin province. There is a small lake on the eastern side of the settlement. The highway between Denizli and Dazkiri passes through the eastern side of the settlement.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Aydin ilinin Dazkiri ilcesine bagli Sarikavak koyunun guney ve guneydogu tarafinda yer almaktadir. Yerlesimin dogu tarafinda kucuk bir gol bulunmaktadir. Denizli ile Dazkiri arasindaki karayolu yerlesimin dogu tarafindan gecmektedir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich im Suden und Sudosten des Dorfes Sarikavak im Bezirk Dazkiri der Provinz Aydin. An der Ostseite der Siedlung befindet sich ein kleiner See. Die Autobahn zwischen Denizli und Dazkiri fuhrt durch die Ostseite der Siedlung.

description: The tell settlement is located in the village of Kusura in the district of Sandikli in the province of Afyonkarahisar. The site was excavated between 1935 and 1937 under the direction of Winfried Lamb.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Afyonkarahisar ilinin Sandikli ilcesine bagli Kusura koyunde yer almaktadir. Yerlesim 1935-1937 yillari arasinda Winfried Lamb baskanliginda kazilmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich im Dorf Kusura im Bezirk Sandikli in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Die Statte wurde zwischen 1935 und 1937 unter der Leitung von Winfried Lamb ausgegraben.

description: The Tell settlement is located in the village of Yamanlar, Civril district, Denizli province. Some of the modern houses have been built on the archaeological site, so part of it has been destroyed.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Denizli ilinin Civril ilcesine bagli Yamanlar koyunde yer almaktadir. Modern evlerin bir kismi arkeolojik alan uzerine insa edilmistir, bu nedenle bir kismi tahrip olmustur.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich in dem Dorf Yamanlar, Bezirk Civril, Provinz Denizli. Einige der modernen Hauser wurden auf der archaologischen Statte errichtet, so dass ein Teil der Statte zerstort worden ist.

description: The Tell settlement is located about 2.5 km northeast of Bademagaci district in Antalya province. It is located on the natural way between inner West Anatolia and the Gulf of Antalya.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Antalya ilinin Bademagaci ilcesinin yaklasik 2,5 km kuzeydogusunda yer almaktadir. Ic Bati Anadolu ile Antalya Korfezi arasindaki dogal yol uzerinde yer almaktadir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich etwa 2,5 km nordostlich des Bezirks Bademagaci in der Provinz Antalya. Sie befindet sich auf dem naturlichen Weg zwischen dem inneren Westanatolien und dem Golf von Antalya.

description: The famous ancient city of Perge is located within the boundaries of the district of Aksu in the province of Antalya , about 18 km northeast of Antalya .
tr_description: Unlu antik kent Perge ilce sinirlari icerisinde yer almaktadir. Aksu eyaletinde Antalya , about 18 km kuzeydogusu Antalya .
de_description: Die beruhmte antike Stadt von Perge befindet sich innerhalb der Grenzen des Bezirks Aksu in der Provinz Antalya , etwa 18 km nordostlich von Antalya .

description: The tell settlement was known in ancient times as a Roman colony under the name of Komama. It is located on a wide plain about 2.5 km east of the village of Urkutlu in the district of Bucak in the province of Burdur. The site is located at a strategic point where several natural transportation routes intersect. From west to east, a main road, which was extended in Roman times to form the Via Sebaste, connected northern Pisidia and southern Phrygia with Pamphylia. At this point, a path branches off to the north, leading along the former lake of Kestel (Paludes) to Kremna and Sagalassos. Another path leads southwest across the Elmali plain to Lycia.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi antik cagda Komama adiyla bir Roma kolonisi olarak biliniyordu. Burdur ilinin Bucak ilcesine bagli Urkutlu koyunun yaklasik 2,5 km dogusunda genis bir duzlukte yer almaktadir. Saha, bircok dogal ulasim yolunun kesistigi stratejik bir noktada yer almaktadir. Batidan doguya dogru, Roma doneminde Via Sebaste'yi olusturacak sekilde genisletilen bir ana yol, kuzey Pisidia ve guney Phrygia'yi Pamphylia'ya baglamaktadir. Bu noktada, bir patika kuzeye saparak eski Kestel (Paludes) golu boyunca Kremna ve Sagalassos'a gider. Bir baska yol guneybatiya, Elmali Ovasi uzerinden Likya'ya uzanir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung war in der Antike als romische Kolonie unter dem Namen Komama bekannt. Sie befindet sich in einer weiten Ebene etwa 2,5 km ostlich des Dorfes Urkutlu im Bezirk Bucak in der Provinz Burdur. Der Ort befindet sich an einem strategischen Punkt, an dem sich mehrere naturliche Transportwege kreuzen. Von Westen nach Osten verband eine Hauptstraﬂe, die in romischer Zeit zur Via Sebaste ausgebaut wurde, das nordliche Pisidien und das sudliche Phrygien mit Pamphylien. An dieser Stelle zweigt ein Weg nach Norden ab, der entlang des ehemaligen Sees von Kestel (Paludes) nach Kremna und Sagalassos fuhrt. Ein anderer Weg fuhrt sudwestlich uber die Elmali-Ebene nach Lykien.

description: The tell settlement is located 500 west of the village of Koyunbeyli in the province of Usak. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Usak iline bagli Koyunbeyli koyunun 500 batisinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 500 westlich des Dorfes Koyunbeyli in der Provinz Usak. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The Tell settlement is located on the northern side of Kediyunu village in Usak province. The village cemetery is located on the archaeological site. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Usak iline bagli Kediyunu koyunun kuzey tarafinda yer almaktadir. Koy mezarligi arkeolojik sit alani uzerinde yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich an der Nordseite des Dorfes Kediyunu in der Provinz Usak. Der Dorffriedhof befindet sich auf der archaologischen Statte. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.3 km west of the village of Kilinckaya in the district of Suhut in the province of Afyonkarahisar. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Suhut ilcesine bagli Kilinckaya koyunun 1,3 km batisinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1,3 km westlich des Dorfes Kilinckaya im Bezirk Suhut in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located 200 meters north of the village of Oynagan in the district of Suhut in the province of Afyonkarahisar. No excavations have been carried out so far. The village cemetery is located on the hill with the site and surrounds half of it. There is a marsh on the eastern side.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Suhut ilcesine bagli Oynagan koyunun 200 metre kuzeyinde yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir. Koy mezarligi alanin bulundugu tepede yer almakta ve alanin yarisini cevrelemektedir. Dogu tarafinda bir bataklik bulunmaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 200 Meter nordlich des Dorfes Oynagan im Bezirk Suhut in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt. Der Dorffriedhof befindet sich auf dem Hugel mit der Statte und umgibt die Halfte davon. An der Ostseite befindet sich ein Sumpf.

description: The tell settlement is located about 800 m northwest of the village of Karaadilli in the district of Suhut in the province of Afyonkarahisar. No excavations have been carried out so far. Anthropogenic deposits form almost no visible elevation as the site has been leveled by agriculture.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Suhut ilcesine bagli Karaadilli koyunun yaklasik 800 m kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir. Antropojenik birikintiler, alan tarimla duzlestirildigi icin neredeyse hic gorunur yukselti olusturmamaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich etwa 800 m nordwestlich des Dorfes Karaadilli im Bezirk Suhut in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt. Die anthropogenen Ablagerungen bilden fast keine sichtbaren Erhebungen, da der Ort durch die Landwirtschaft eingeebnet wurde.

description: The tell settlement is located 3.2 km north of the village of Karaadilli in the district town of Suhut in the province of Afyonkarahisar. No excavations have been carried out so far. The highway between Cay and Dinar runs 1.5 km to the east.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Suhut ilcesine bagli Karaadilli koyunun 3,2 km kuzeyinde yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir. Cay ve Dinar arasindaki karayolu 1,5 km dogusundan gecmektedir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 3,2 km nordlich des Dorfes Karaadilli in der Kreisstadt Suhut in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt. Die Fernstraﬂe zwischen Cay und Dinar verlauft 1,5 km ostlich.

description: The tell settlement is located about 350 m south of the village of Kulak in the district of Suhut in the province of Afyonkarahisar. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Suhut ilcesine bagli Kulak koyunun yaklasik 350 m guneyinde yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich etwa 350 m sudlich des Dorfes Kulak im Bezirk Suhut in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The tell settlement is located on the eastern side of the village of Anayurt in the district of Suhut in the province of Afyonkarahisar. No excavations have been carried out so far. The village cemetery, including the tomb of an Islamic saint, rests on the settlement.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Afyonkarahisar ilinin Suhut ilcesine bagli Anayurt koyunun dogu tarafinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir. Yerlesimin uzerinde bir Islam evliyasinin turbesinin de bulundugu koy mezarligi bulunmaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich an der Ostseite des Dorfes Anayurt im Bezirk Suhut in der Provinz Afyonkarahisar. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt. Der Dorffriedhof, einschlieﬂlich des Grabes eines islamischen Heiligen, ruht auf der Siedlung.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.5 km northeast of the district of Kiziloren in the province of Afyonakarahisar. No excavations have been carried out so far. There is a saint's tomb on the eastern side of the settlement. The highway between Sandikli and Dinar runs 1.5 km east of the site.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Afyonakarahisar ili Kiziloren ilcesinin 1,5 km kuzeydogusunda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir. Yerlesimin dogu tarafinda bir evliya turbesi bulunmaktadir. Sandikli ile Dinar arasindaki karayolu yerlesimin 1,5 km dogusundan gecmektedir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1,5 km nordostlich des Bezirks Kiziloren in der Provinz Afyonakarahisar. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt. An der Ostseite der Siedlung befindet sich ein Heiligengrab. Die Landstraﬂe zwischen Sandikli und Dinar verlauft 1,5 km ostlich des Ortes.

description: The tell settlement is located 1 km east of the village of Asagikuzfindik in the Inonu district of the city of Eskisehir. The site was discovered in 1989 by Turan Efe and has been excavated since 2013 under the direction of Ali Umut Turkcan of Anadolu University.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Eskisehir ilinin Inonu ilcesine bagli Asagikuzfindik koyunun 1 km dogusunda yer almaktadir. Yerlesim 1989 yilinda Turan Efe tarafindan kesfedilmis ve 2013 yilindan bu yana Anadolu Universitesi'nden Ali Umut Turkcan baskanliginda kazilmaktadir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1 km ostlich des Dorfes Asagikuzfindik im Bezirk Inonu der Stadt Eskisehir. Die Statte wurde 1989 von Turan Efe entdeckt und wird seit 2013 unter der Leitung von Ali Umut Turkcan von der Anadolu Universitat ausgegraben.

description: The ancient city of Tymion is located in the village of Sukraniye near the provincial town of Usak. No excavations have been carried out so far, but between 2006 and 2008 the village and its surroundings were intensively studied by Peter Lampe of the University of Heidelberg.
tr_description: Tymion antik kenti, Usak ili yakinlarindaki Sukraniye koyunde yer almaktadir. Bugune kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir, ancak 2006 ve 2008 yillari arasinda koy ve cevresi Heidelberg Universitesi'nden Peter Lampe tarafindan yogun bir sekilde incelenmistir.
de_description: Die antike Stadt Tymion befindet sich im Dorf Sukraniye in der Nahe der Provinzstadt Usak. Bislang wurden keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt, aber zwischen 2006 und 2008 wurden das Dorf und seine Umgebung von Peter Lampe von der Universitat Heidelberg intensiv untersucht.

description: The tell settlement is located about 4 km west of the district of Pinarhisar in the province of Kirikkale. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Kirikkale ili Pinarhisar ilcesinin yaklasik 4 km batisinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi calismasi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich etwa 4 km westlich des Bezirks Pinarhisar in der Provinz Kirikkale. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The settlement is located on the north-eastern side of the municipality of Yenidogan in the district of Soke in the province of Aydin. No excavations have been carried out so far.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Aydin ilinin Soke ilcesine bagli Yenidogan beldesinin kuzeydogu tarafinda yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir kazi yapilmamistir.
de_description: Die Siedlung liegt an der nordostlichen Seite der Gemeinde Yenidogan im Bezirk Soke in der Provinz Aydin. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt.

description: The settlement is located 1 km northeast of Halilbeyli village in Kocarli district of Aydin province. The site is located on a small hill on the southern side of the Meander Valley. The area is now used as an olive grove.
tr_description: Yerlesim, Aydin ilinin Kocarli ilcesine bagli Halilbeyli koyunun 1 km kuzeydogusunda yer almaktadir. Menderes Vadisi'nin guney tarafinda kucuk bir tepe uzerinde yer almaktadir. Alan gunumuzde zeytinlik olarak kullanilmaktadir.
de_description: Die Siedlung befindet sich 1 km nordostlich des Dorfes Halilbeyli im Bezirk Kocarli der Provinz Aydin. Der Ort befindet sich auf einem kleinen Hugel an der Sudseite des Maandertals. Das Gebiet wird heute als Olivenhain genutzt.

description: Golhisar Fortress is located about 1 km southwest of the village of Golhisar in Aydin province. Traces of Iron Age walls (1.4-1.6 m thick) are visible in the area today. Architectural remains from this period are also visible. The area was probably used as a fortress in the Iron Age and Late Bronze Age, as indicated by the Turkish name Kale (fortress).
tr_description: Golhisar Kalesi, Aydin iline bagli Golhisar koyunun yaklasik 1 km guneybatisinda yer almaktadir. Alanda bugun Demir Cagi'na ait duvar izleri (1,4-1,6 m kalinliginda) gorulebilmektedir. Bu doneme ait mimari kalintilar da gorulebilmektedir. Alan, Turkce Kale adindan da anlasilacagi uzere, muhtemelen Demir Cagi ve Gec Tunc Cagi'nda bir kale olarak kullanilmistir.
de_description: Die Festung Golhisar befindet sich etwa 1 km sudwestlich des Dorfes Golhisar in der Provinz Aydin. Spuren von Mauern aus der Eisenzeit (1,4-1,6 m dick) sind heute in der Gegend sichtbar. Auch architektonische Uberreste aus dieser Zeit sind sichtbar. Das Gebiet wurde wahrscheinlich in der Eisenzeit und der spaten Bronzezeit als Festung genutzt, worauf der turkische Name Kale (Festung) hinweist.

description: The Tell settlement is located on the western side of Avsa Island in the Marmara District of Balikesir Province. It is located directly on the coast and a large part of the settlement is now under water. According to Nergis Gunsenin, Bronze Age pottery remains can be seen 1.5-2.0 m deep in the water.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Balikesir Ili, Marmara Ilcesi, Avsa Adasi'nin bati yakasinda yer almaktadir. Dogrudan kiyida yer almaktadir ve yerlesimin buyuk bir kismi su anda sular altindadir. Nergis Gunsenin'e gore, suyun 1,5-2,0 m derinliginde Tunc Cagi canak comlek kalintilari gorulebilmektedir.
de_description: Die Tell-Siedlung befindet sich auf der westlichen Seite der Insel Avsa im Bezirk Marmara der Provinz Balikesir. Sie befindet sich direkt an der Kuste und ein groﬂer Teil der Siedlung steht heute unter Wasser. Laut Nergis Gunsenin kann man in 1,5-2,0 m Tiefe im Wasser Uberreste von Keramik aus der Bronzezeit sehen.

description: The tell settlement is located about 1.7 km southeast of the village of Ortaya in the district of Aslanapa in the province of Kutahya. No excavations have been carried out to date. The settlement was first discovered by James Mellaart and then examined in detail by Turan Efe in the 1990s.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi, Kutahya ili Aslanapa ilcesine bagli Ortaya koyunun yaklasik 1,7 km guneydogusunda yer almaktadir. Bugune kadar herhangi bir kazi calismasi yapilmamistir. Yerlesim ilk olarak James Mellaart tarafindan kesfedilmis ve daha sonra 1990'li yillarda Turan Efe tarafindan ayrintili olarak incelenmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich etwa 1,7 km sudostlich des Dorfes Ortaya im Bezirk Aslanapa in der Provinz Kutahya. Bisher wurden noch keine Ausgrabungen durchgefuhrt. Die Siedlung wurde zuerst von James Mellaart entdeckt und dann in den 1990er Jahren von Turan Efe eingehend untersucht.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.2 km south of the village of Kozkayi in the Tepebasi district of Eskisehir province. No research has been carried out so far. The upper part of the settlement was destroyed by looters.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Eskisehir ilinin Tepebasi ilcesine bagli Kozkayi koyunun 1,2 km guneyinde yer almaktadir. Simdiye kadar herhangi bir arastirma yapilmamistir. Yerlesimin ust kismi yagmacilar tarafindan tahrip edilmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung befindet sich 1,2 km sudlich des Dorfes Kozkayi im Bezirk Tepebasi der Provinz Eskisehir. Bislang wurden keine Untersuchungen durchgefuhrt. Der obere Teil der Siedlung wurde von Plunderern zerstort.

description: The tell settlement is located 1.5 km northwest of the village of Oklubali in the Inonu district of Eskisehir. On the northern side of the tell, the art of the ramparts has become visible due to the destruction.
tr_description: Hoyuk yerlesimi Eskisehir'in Inonu ilcesine bagli Oklubali koyunun 1,5 km kuzeybatisinda yer almaktadir. Anlatinin kuzey tarafinda, tahribat nedeniyle surlarin sanati gorunur hale gelmistir.
de_description: Die Tellsiedlung liegt 1,5 km nordwestlich des Dorfes Oklubali im Bezirk Inonu von Eskisehir. An der Nordseite des Tells ist die Kunst der Walle durch die Zerstorung sichtbar geworden.
